description: Time-series DSP fundamentals organized as sub-plugins under DSP.*: Generator, Transform, Window, Frame, Feature, Filter, Stats, Stream, Detect, Tensor, Sensor, Acquire. Most nodes are ONNX kernels; a subset also has UE5 Audio counterparts. Stream, Detect, Tensor, Acquire and Generator are pure runtime nodes.

subPlugins.description: Signal sources. Oscillator emits amplitude·sin/cos(2π·f·t + φ) one sample per tick; f, A, φ available as editables AND as optional input ports (wire a slider to frequency for live sweeps). Compose multi-frequency signals with Add trees: Osc1+Osc2+Osc3 -> Buffer -> FFT.
FFT (power/magnitude/complex modes), IFFT, Magnitude, Phase, DCT.
Window function (Hann, Hamming, Blackman, Bartlett, Rectangular, Tukey) selected via the window_type attribute.
Signal slicing into overlapping frames with hop_length and pad_mode.
Audio-style feature extraction: Mel filterbank, LogScale, MFCC pipeline, DTW distance.
Biquad (LP/HP/BP/Notch via filter_type) and scalar Kalman 1D.
Output-side signal analysis: RMS, Zero-Crossing Rate, Moving Average (causal), Detrend (constant/linear).

Scalar ↔ tensor adapters. Buffer collects N consecutive samples (floats or [C] tensors from Mux) and emits a [frameSize] or [frameSize, C] tensor every hopLength samples: the missing piece to feed a streaming scalar source (Clock, Sin, sensor) into a tensor-consuming DSP pipeline (SpFrame, SpFFT, ...). Mux (variadic in_0, in_1, ...) assembles N parallel float streams into one [N] tensor per tick. Not ONNX-backed: pure runtime impedance matching.

Regime / event detection on scalar streams. Steady-State Gate forwards samples belonging to an established regime (EMA baseline, relative epsilon band, settle/breakHold hysteresis) and closes during transients; publishes the regime flag every tick and a one-shot token on each edge. Not ONNX-backed: pure runtime streaming control flow.

Tensor layout utilities. Transpose turns a row-major [A, B] tensor into [B, A], with an optional leading batch dimension ([1, B, A]): the canonical [T, C] -> (1, C, T) adapter in front of ONNX encoder models. Not ONNX-backed: pure runtime relayout.

Generic signal-conditioning model. Transducer wraps a clean input with a realistic 1st-order LPF + Gaussian noise + quantization + linear drift; compose with sensor-specific defaults (thermocouple, pressure, flow, ...) as thin wrappers.

Block-based data acquisition with its OWN sim-time sampling clock, decoupled from the session tick rate. DAQ samples the (optionally anti-aliased, 1-pole) value line at sample_rate_hz and publishes fixed-size blocks (block tensor + block RMS, capacity 4 for free-mode bursts) every block_size / sample_rate_hz seconds of SIM time. Defaults implement the IEC 61430 / 61407 acquisition profile as specified by the project owner: 10.24 kHz, 200 ms blocks, 2048 samples (fs / N = 5 Hz). Not ONNX-backed: pure runtime acquisition front-end.
